brief.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
brief.text: Meridian survived the storm! Now it is Mars day sixteen. Today you drive the rover to Kestrel Ridge. Take good photos of the rocks. And bring everyone home safe.

spare.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
spare.text: The spare battery is in and locked. The base keeps its own battery too.

checks.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
checks.text: Before we drive, check the rover battery, wheel pin, camera, suits, tools, and radio. If something is wrong, fix it first.

ready.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
ready.text: Both space suits are ready. Remember: always save enough battery and air to get home, plus a little extra.

route.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
route.text: Look at each path. Check the ground and the battery you need to get home. The shortest path is not always the best one.

departure.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
departure.text: Meridian, the rover is rolling! Amara is with me. We will radio you if anything changes.

haze.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
haze.text: It is getting hazy. I cannot see far. Let's slow down and steer by the rocks near us.

hazard.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
hazard.text: Look! The ground ahead is cracked, with soft dust under it. Stop on firm ground so we can look first.

slip.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
slip.text: The wheels are spinning! Let go of the gas. Look at the ground. Then back up slowly if it is clear behind us.

detour.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
detour.text: I marked the soft spot on our map. We will go around it on firm ground.

ridge.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
ridge.text: We made it to the ridge! First, take a wide photo of both kinds of rock. Then take a close photo with the ruler.

science.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
science.text: Dark rock on the bottom. Light layers on top. We wrote down where we found them. We still don't know how they formed. That is a mystery to study!

sample.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
sample.text: That little rock is a bonus. Only take it if we still have enough battery to get home. Our photos are already great.

return.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
return.text: Meridian, we are heading home. Our photos are saved, and we still have battery left.

dock.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
dock.text: Rover parked, brake on. Jin and Amara are home!

success.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
success.text: Great job! You changed the plan when the ground looked risky. You took good photos. And you got home with battery to spare.

abort.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
abort.text: Everyone is home safe. That matters most! We can go back for the science another day.

margin.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
margin.text: You made it home, but the battery got really low. Next time, think about where the battery went.

suspended.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
suspended.text: Let's pause here. Look at the warning. Then try again from your last safe spot.
